doc: THE record of the owner's iPhone windows (issue #5218): CSS px size and env(safe-area-inset-*) per window. Every tool and helper that emulates his phone reads this file: tools/lib/bryce-phone.mjs (BRYCE_WINDOWS), tests/helpers/title-fit.mjs (GEOS) and tools/ui/menu-screens.mjs (the ios-iphone-landscape* cells). `measured` says what a real-device reading confirmed; `assumed` names what it did not. Change a number only from a new reading, and cite it in `source`.

standalone.measured: nothing on the device yet: size and insets are the Chromium emulation read back in PR #5216
standalone.assumed: size and insets (the Home Screen app reading is still open on #5218)
standalone.verified: Home Screen app. Chromium emulation read-back (PR #5216); insets on the real device pending #5218

safari.measured: size: inner = documentElement.client = visualViewport = 852x368, scale 1, DPR 3, iOS 18_7 Safari tab, landscape title menu and race
safari.assumed: insets (env() was not read; taken equal to standalone) and the toolbar state (expanded or collapsed was not recorded)
safari.source: #5218 comment 2026-11-10T02:40Z (phone bridge thread #5168, live build e808230)
safari.verified: Safari tab. Size MEASURED on his iPhone over the phone bridge 2026-11-10 02:40Z (#5218, DPR 3); insets ASSUMED equal to standalone

w844.assumed: the iPhone 12-14 full-screen cell most reports and specs were written against
